limitations: Snapshot contains 14,911 segments / 3,921,429,823 bytes (about 96% of roughly 15.6k current segments). The slower double-scan startup path was not measured.
replay_scope: --fast ran one Store manifest/replay pass over every finalized snapshot segment with checkpoints; it disabled Store's separate pre-open verify scan. Mutable .open/status files were excluded; finalized .seg/.json inputs were hard-linked into /tmp staging.

snapshot.storage: hard links to finalized immutable .seg/.json files; .open and mutable status excluded
